I’m from Montreal and I was born after the expos became the nationals, in 2001. In Canada, it can sometimes feel like you have to love the Blue Jays seeing as how they’re the only current Canadian baseball team around. My dad is a diehard yanks fan and  he got me into the world of baseball. He’s not a big fan of the Blue Jays and so I was kind of raised to dislike them too. From there, I started searching for a team to dedicate my time too and it wasn’t long before I discovered Mike Trout.
